title: VRAM 自动增强 & 智能感知

standard.summary: VRAM 自动增强套件：智能感知（smart_sensing）在训练前几步测量实际 VRAM 使用量，并自动推荐优化措施；vram_swap_to_ram 允许将不活跃权重换到 CPU RAM；startup_guard 在训练启动时预防 OOM。
standard.effect: smart_sensing 在 baseline_steps 步内监控 VRAM，检测 slowdown_ratio（VRAM 使用率超阈值时速度下降信号），delta_cache 记录增量变化。startup_guard 在开始训练前分配测试内存，预防编译或首步 OOM 爆炸。
standard.whenToUse: 显存使用不稳定（偶发 OOM）或想自动诊断 VRAM 瓶颈时开启。
standard.avoidWhen: 稳定训练（从不 OOM）时无需开启监控，有额外开销。

standard_en.summary: The VRAM auto-enhancement suite: smart sensing (smart_sensing) measures actual VRAM use over the first few training steps and recommends optimisations automatically; vram_swap_to_ram allows inactive weights to be swapped out to CPU RAM; startup_guard prevents an OOM at training startup.
standard_en.effect: smart_sensing monitors VRAM over baseline_steps steps and detects slowdown_ratio (the slowdown signal when VRAM utilisation passes a threshold), with delta_cache recording the incremental change. startup_guard allocates test memory before training starts, to head off an OOM blow-up during compilation or on the first step.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on when VRAM use is unstable (occasional OOM) or when you want an automatic diagnosis of the VRAM bottleneck.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Stable training (never OOMs) needs no monitoring, and it carries some overhead.

advanced.principle: smart_sensing 在 baseline_steps 步内以更频繁的频率记录 VRAM 使用量，建立基线；之后转为定期检查（配合 peak_vram_diagnostics）。vram_swap_to_ram 通过 torch.cuda.memory 的 reserved → system RAM 策略实现（非 offload，只是内存管理策略）。anima_block_residency_min_params 控制块驻留 GPU 所需的最小参数量（小块不值得常驻 GPU）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 频繁 VRAM 监控有约 0.5~1ms/step 额外开销；startup_guard 分配的测试内存在验证后立即释放，但可能延迟训练开始约 10~30 秒。

advanced_en.principle: smart_sensing records VRAM usage at a more frequent rate for baseline_steps to build a baseline; afterwards it switches to periodic checks (paired with peak_vram_diagnostics). vram_swap_to_ram is implemented through the torch.cuda.memory reserved → system RAM strategy (not offload, just a memory management strategy). anima_block_residency_min_params controls the minimum parameter count for a block to stay resident on GPU (small blocks are not worth keeping resident).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Frequent VRAM monitoring adds about 0.5~1ms/step overhead; the test memory allocated by startup_guard is freed immediately after verification, but may delay training start by about 10~30 seconds.
